# MCP tools

The tools Folio offers to AI assistants, over HTTP (in the app) and stdio (the bridge). Write tools run only when **Let AI edit notes** is on. *App only* tools need the app to be open.

| Tool | Writes | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `list_notes` | no | List Markdown notes in the workspace, most recently modified first. |
| `read_note` | no | Read the full Markdown of a note, or a line range. |
| `search_notes` | no | Full-text search across every note. Returns paths and matching lines with line numbers. |
| `get_outline` | no | Return the heading structure of a note: level, text, first line and last line of each section (sub-sections included). |
| `get_format_guide` | no | Return the syntax of Folio document types: pages (.md: footnotes, maths, colour, alignment, hidden comments), slides-md (.slides.md, Marp compatible), board-md (.board.md diagrams), sheet-md (.sheet.md spreadsheets), or the guide to building slide templates (type template: colours, fonts, masters with placeholders, variants; templates live in Templates/). |
| `get_sheet_values` | no | Evaluate every formula in a .sheet.md note and return each sheet as a grid of computed values, with cell addresses. |
| `get_open_note` *(app only)* | no | Return the note the user has open in Folio right now, its unsaved text and the current selection. |
| `create_note` | yes | Create a new note. Fails if the path already exists. |
| `write_note` | yes | Replace the entire content of a note (creates it if missing). Prefer edit_note for small changes. |
| `edit_note` | yes | Apply exact find-and-replace edits to a note. Each oldText must match exactly once unless replaceAll is set. |
| `append_to_note` | yes | Append Markdown to the end of a note, or to the end of the section under a given heading. |
| `resolve_ref` | no | Compute what a Folio reference points at, as Folio would show it: a sheet cell value or range, a slide title, a board shape label, or a page section. Reference syntax: "Doc#part", e.g. "Budget.sheet#Summary!B7", "Pitch.slides#3", "System.board#api", "Roadmap#Goals". |
| `get_backlinks` | no | List every link ([[..]]), live value ({{..}}) and embed (![[..]]) in the workspace that points at a document. |
| `find_broken_links` | no | List references whose target document does not exist, in one document or the whole workspace. |
| `find_unused_assets` | no | List pictures, media and attachments in the hidden .asset folders that no page references (candidates for clean-up; Folio asks the user before removing anything), with their size. |
| `find_missing_assets` | no | List asset references (images, media, attachments) whose file does not exist, with the page and line. |
| `read_section` | no | Read one section of a page: a heading and everything under it. Name the heading ("Goals"), give a path to tell twins apart ("Plan > Goals"), or pass its line from get_outline. |
| `replace_section` | yes | Replace what is under a heading (sub-sections included) with new Markdown. The heading line stays unless includeHeading is true, in which case content must start with its own heading. The rest of the page is untouched. |
| `insert_after` | yes | Insert Markdown as new blocks after a heading's section (sub-sections included) or after the block that ends with a block id, e.g. "^a1b2c3". |
| `add_comment` | yes | Comment on a passage of a page. The passage is highlighted and the comment written as CriticMarkup ({==passage==}{>>You, date: comment<<}), which Folio shows in its Review tab and other editors show as plain text. |
| `suggest_edit` | yes | Propose a change as a tracked suggestion the user can accept or reject, instead of editing the text: oldText → newText, or delete oldText (newText empty), or add newText after insertAfter. Optional comment explains why. |
| `resolve_link` | no | Say where a link points: pass "[[Note#Heading\|label]]" or "Note#^id". Returns the document path (or that it does not exist, with similar names), its type, and the heading or block it targets with line numbers. |
| `list_versions` | no | List the saved versions of a document, newest first: id, time, who made it (you or an AI client), why, words added or removed, and the name if the user named it. |
| `get_version` | no | Read the full text of a saved version (id from list_versions; a prefix is enough, or "latest"). |
| `diff_versions` | no | Show what changed between two versions as a unified diff, with the number of words added and removed. "to" defaults to the current text of the file; "current" and "latest" are accepted. |
| `restore_version` | yes | Put a saved version back as the document's text. The current text is saved as a version first, so the restore itself can be undone. |
| `move_note` | yes | Move or rename a note inside the workspace. References to it in other documents are updated. |
| `open_note` *(app only)* | no | Open a note in Folio so the user sees it, optionally scrolled to a line. |
| `list_slides` | no | List the slides of a deck: number, title, layout, section, hidden, transition, number of placed objects and animations, and whether it has speaker notes. |
| `list_slide_objects` | no | List the placed objects on a slide with id, kind, geometry in px (the slide is 1280×720 for 16:9), attributes, text and link. Use the ids with the other slide tools. |
| `add_object` | yes | Place an object on a slide at x, y, w, h (px). kind: box, shape, line, icon, media, path, smartart, zoom. attrs are slides-md attributes (fill, stroke, border, radius, size, color, font, align, valign, type for shapes, name for icons, link, …). text is Markdown for boxes and shapes. For an image use kind=image with attrs.src. Returns the new id. |
| `move_object` | yes | Change the position, size or rotation of an object (px, degrees). Give only what changes. |
| `restyle_object` | yes | Set or remove attributes of an object: a value sets it, null removes it. Also sets its Markdown text when text is given. |
| `remove_object` | yes | Remove an object from a slide, with any animation of it. |
| `set_animations` | yes | Replace the build order of a slide. Each line: target (#id or body), effect, then trigger (click, with, after), duration (0.5s), delay=, repeat=, by=paragraph. Effects: appear, fade-in, zoom-in, grow-in, fly-in-left, fly-in-right, fly-in-up, fly-in-down, float-in, wipe-in, spin-in, bounce-in, pulse, spin, grow, teeter, flash, shake, disappear, fade-out, zoom-out, fly-out-left, fly-out-right, fly-out-up, fly-out-down, wipe-out, path-left, path-right, path-up, path-down, path-arc, path-custom. An empty list removes all animations. |
| `set_transition` | yes | Set the transition into a slide, or for every slide with slide omitted. Name and optional duration, e.g. "push-left 0.6s"; "none" removes it. Names: none, fade, fade-black, dissolve, push-left, push-right, push-up, push-down, wipe-left, wipe-right, wipe-up, wipe-down, cover-left, cover-right, uncover-left, uncover-right, split, reveal, zoom, zoom-out, iris, clock, blinds, flip, cube, fall, morph. Morph moves objects with the same id between consecutive slides. |
| `rewrite_links` | yes | Change every object link= in a deck from one target to another (e.g. "slide:4" to "slide:6", or an old web address). Returns how many changed. |
| `set_alt_text` | yes | Set the alternative text read by screen readers for a picture, icon, chart or diagram object. Write what the picture shows and why it matters, in one or two sentences. |
| `set_speaker_notes` | yes | Replace the speaker notes of a slide (plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines). |
| `get_design_ideas` | no | Suggest layouts for a slide from its content (the same ideas the Designer pane shows). Returns idea ids and labels; apply one with apply_design_idea. |
| `apply_design_idea` | yes | Replace a slide with one of the layouts from get_design_ideas. Its text is kept. |
| `get_board` | no | List the shapes (id, shape, label, position, size, style) and connectors (from, to, operator, label) of a .board.md note, plus lines that could not be read. |
| `add_shape` | yes | Add a shape to a board. shape: rect, rounded, ellipse, circle, diamond, triangle, hexagon, parallelogram, trapezoid, star, cloud, cylinder, document, note, callout, step, cube, cross, text, terminator, predefined, manual, delay, connector, offpage, class, interface, actor, usecase, package, component, lifeline, state, initial, final, activity, fork, frame, table, server, queue, browser, mobile, group, swimlane. Leave x and y out to have the shape placed by auto layout. body lines are used by class, interface, table and note shapes. |
| `update_shape` | yes | Change a shape: label, position, size, shape type, body, or style (a value sets a style key, null removes it). Give only what changes. |
| `remove_shape` | yes | Remove a shape and every connector attached to it. |
| `connect` | yes | Add a connector between two shapes that exist on the board. op: ->  -->  --  ..  <->  -\|>  ..\|>  *--  o--  ..>. fromPort and toPort pick a side (top, right, bottom, left). |
| `disconnect` | yes | Remove the connector(s) from one shape to another. |
| `auto_layout_board` | yes | Place shapes with the dagre layout. By default only shapes without a position are placed (to the right of the rest); all: true re-lays out everything. |
| `set_cells` | yes | Set cells of a .sheet.md sheet by A1 address, e.g. {"A1": "Name", "B2": 12.5, "C2": "=B2*2"}. Text starting with = is a formula; null or "" clears a cell. The grid grows as needed. Other cells and other sheets are untouched. |
| `add_sheet` | yes | Add a sheet (a table under a ## heading) to a .sheet.md note, creating the note when it does not exist. rows[0] is the header row. |

## `list_notes`

| `folder` | string | no | Sub-folder to list, relative to the workspace |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |

## `get_format_guide`

Return the syntax of Folio document types: pages (.md: footnotes, maths, colour, alignment, hidden comments), slides-md (.slides.md, Marp compatible), board-md (.board.md diagrams), sheet-md (.sheet.md spreadsheets), or the guide to building slide templates (type template: colours, fonts, masters with placeholders, variants; templates live in Templates/).

## `resolve_ref`

Compute what a Folio reference points at, as Folio would show it: a sheet cell value or range, a slide title, a board shape label, or a page section. Reference syntax: "Doc#part", e.g. "Budget.sheet#Summary!B7", "Pitch.slides#3", "System.board#api", "Roadmap#Goals".

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | string | yes |  |

List pictures, media and attachments in the hidden .asset folders that no page references (candidates for clean-up; Folio asks the user before removing anything), with their size.

## `read_section`

Read one section of a page: a heading and everything under it. Name the heading ("Goals"), give a path to tell twins apart ("Plan > Goals"), or pass its line from get_outline.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `heading` | string | no |  |
| `line` | integer | no |  |
| `includeChildren` | boolean | no | Include sub-sections (default true) |

## `replace_section`

Replace what is under a heading (sub-sections included) with new Markdown. The heading line stays unless includeHeading is true, in which case content must start with its own heading. The rest of the page is untouched.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `heading` | string | no |  |
| `line` | integer | no |  |
| `content` | string | yes |  |
| `includeHeading` | boolean | no |  |

## `insert_after`

Insert Markdown as new blocks after a heading's section (sub-sections included) or after the block that ends with a block id, e.g. "^a1b2c3".

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `after` | string | yes | A heading ("Goals", "Plan > Goals") or a block id ("^a1b2c3") |
| `line` | integer | no | Line of the heading, when its text is not unique |
| `content` | string | yes |  |

## `add_comment`

Comment on a passage of a page. The passage is highlighted and the comment written as CriticMarkup ({==passage==}{>>You, date: comment<<}), which Folio shows in its Review tab and other editors show as plain text.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `quote` | string | yes | The exact passage to comment on |
| `comment` | string | yes |  |
| `occurrence` | integer | no | Which match, when the passage appears more than once |
| `author` | string | no |  |

## `suggest_edit`

Propose a change as a tracked suggestion the user can accept or reject, instead of editing the text: oldText → newText, or delete oldText (newText empty), or add newText after insertAfter. Optional comment explains why.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `oldText` | string | no |  |
| `newText` | string | no |  |
| `insertAfter` | string | no |  |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `occurrence` | integer | no |  |
| `author` | string | no |  |

## `resolve_link`

Say where a link points: pass "[[Note#Heading|label]]" or "Note#^id". Returns the document path (or that it does not exist, with similar names), its type, and the heading or block it targets with line numbers.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link` | string | yes |  |
| `from` | string | no | Path of the page containing the link, for relative names |

## `list_versions`

List the saved versions of a document, newest first: id, time, who made it (you or an AI client), why, words added or removed, and the name if the user named it.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |

## `get_version`

Read the full text of a saved version (id from list_versions; a prefix is enough, or "latest").

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

## `diff_versions`

Show what changed between two versions as a unified diff, with the number of words added and removed. "to" defaults to the current text of the file; "current" and "latest" are accepted.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `from` | string | yes |  |
| `to` | string | no |  |

## `restore_version`

Put a saved version back as the document's text. The current text is saved as a version first, so the restore itself can be undone.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

## `add_object`

Place an object on a slide at x, y, w, h (px). kind: box, shape, line, icon, media, path, smartart, zoom. attrs are slides-md attributes (fill, stroke, border, radius, size, color, font, align, valign, type for shapes, name for icons, link, …). text is Markdown for boxes and shapes. For an image use kind=image with attrs.src. Returns the new id.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `kind` | `box`, `shape`, `line`, `icon`, `media`, `path`, `smartart`, `zoom`, `image` | yes |  |
| `x` | number | yes |  |
| `y` | number | yes |  |
| `w` | number | yes |  |
| `h` | number | yes |  |
| `text` | string | no |  |
| `attrs` | object | no |  |
| `id` | string | no | Object id without the # |

## `set_animations`

Replace the build order of a slide. Each line: target (#id or body), effect, then trigger (click, with, after), duration (0.5s), delay=, repeat=, by=paragraph. Effects: appear, fade-in, zoom-in, grow-in, fly-in-left, fly-in-right, fly-in-up, fly-in-down, float-in, wipe-in, spin-in, bounce-in, pulse, spin, grow, teeter, flash, shake, disappear, fade-out, zoom-out, fly-out-left, fly-out-right, fly-out-up, fly-out-down, wipe-out, path-left, path-right, path-up, path-down, path-arc, path-custom. An empty list removes all animations.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `animations` | array | yes |  |

## `set_transition`

Set the transition into a slide, or for every slide with slide omitted. Name and optional duration, e.g. "push-left 0.6s"; "none" removes it. Names: none, fade, fade-black, dissolve, push-left, push-right, push-up, push-down, wipe-left, wipe-right, wipe-up, wipe-down, cover-left, cover-right, uncover-left, uncover-right, split, reveal, zoom, zoom-out, iris, clock, blinds, flip, cube, fall, morph. Morph moves objects with the same id between consecutive slides.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | no | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `transition` | string | yes |  |

| `y` | number | no |  |
| `w` | number | no |  |
| `h` | number | no |  |
| `style` | object | no |  |
| `body` | array | no |  |

## `remove_shape`

Remove a shape and every connector attached to it.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .board.md note |
| `id` | string | yes | Shape id (letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter) |

## `connect`

Add a connector between two shapes that exist on the board. op: ->  -->  --  ..  <->  -|>  ..|>  *--  o--  ..>. fromPort and toPort pick a side (top, right, bottom, left).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .board.md note |
| `from` | string | yes | Shape id (letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter) |
| `to` | string | yes | Shape id (letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter) |
| `op` | `->`, `-->`, `--`, `..`, `<->`, `-\|>`, `..\|>`, `*--`, `o--`, `..>` | yes |  |
| `label` | string | no |  |
| `fromPort` | `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left` | no |  |
| `toPort` | `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left` | no |  |
| `style` | object | no |  |

## `disconnect`

Remove the connector(s) from one shape to another.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .board.md note |
| `from` | string | yes | Shape id (letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter) |
| `to` | string | yes | Shape id (letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter) |

## `auto_layout_board`

Place shapes with the dagre layout. By default only shapes without a position are placed (to the right of the rest); all: true re-lays out everything.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .board.md note |
| `dir` | `LR`, `TB`, `RL`, `BT` | no |  |
| `all` | boolean | no |  |

## `set_cells`

Set cells of a .sheet.md sheet by A1 address, e.g. {"A1": "Name", "B2": 12.5, "C2": "=B2*2"}. Text starting with = is a formula; null or "" clears a cell. The grid grows as needed. Other cells and other sheets are untouched.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .sheet.md note |
| `sheet` | string | no | Sheet name; the first sheet when omitted |
| `cells` | object | yes |  |

## `add_sheet`

Add a sheet (a table under a ## heading) to a .sheet.md note, creating the note when it does not exist. rows[0] is the header row.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .sheet.md note |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `rows` | array | no |  |
